visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a large, beige-colored cosmetic travel bag placed on a clean white surface. A hand with manicured nails points to a pack of white wet wipes featuring the Wittle brand logo. The background is brightly lit, showing a minimalist studio setting with soft shadows. (2) The hand reaches into the top mesh pocket of the open bag and pulls out a white tube of makeup remover, presenting it to the camera. Behind it, several other white and gold skin care products are neatly organized in rows within the bag's clear internal compartments. (3) In a series of fast cuts, the hand consecutively pulls out and displays various items including a gold-capped primer tube, a sleek black dry shampoo spray bottle, and a translucent glass bottle containing white serum. The lighting remains bright and consistent across all product shots. (4) The hand then reveals two large, white and gold jars labeled as sleeping masks and neck creams. The textures of the packaging are smooth and matte, reflecting the high-key studio lights. The camera remains static while the hand moves items in and out of the frame. (5) The hand fans out multiple gold foil packets of hand, foot, and neck masks before pulling out a white hand-held mirror with the Wittle logo. Finally, a steam eye mask package and several individual sheet masks are shown. The hand then zips the cosmetic bag shut.
